capabilities: Track personal quests and award fixed XP on completion
Level up a profile with an XP progress bar
Create, edit, complete, and delete quests and achievements
Browse a searchable library of 100 quest templates
View completed quest history grouped by date
extras: Installation requires manually copying the plugin folder into .obsidian/plugins/; data is stored in Obsidian plugin data rather than notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track personal goals as a gamified quest system with XP, levels, and achievements.
summary: Gamification dashboard that tracks personal quests, awards XP, levels up a profile, and manages achievements inside Obsidian.
